Can Trump's electoral setbacks change the course of the Iran war? Can the US-Russia-China G3 reshape global conflicts? Can India deter China and reclaim Aksai Chin? With the US stepping back from COP31, are climate summits losing relevance?
On this episode of Geopolitics with Swasti, ThePrint’s Consulting Editor for International and Strategic Affairs, Dr Swasti Rao, unpacks the strategic stakes of the G3 meeting, the future of the Iran war, India's potential role in Ukraine's reconstruction, and why mediation in the Middle East is more complicated.
